_description: Model id and default reasoning effort per delegation role, read by codex-delegate.mjs at run time. Shared across machines: edit, commit, push, pull, deploy. Per-machine overrides go in models.local.json (gitignored, same shape, any subset of roles/fields). Valid efforts: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh. Roles themselves (prompts, sandbox, contracts) are defined in scripts/codex-delegate.mjs and are not configurable here. Author: maintained with Claude Code for the frontier-model orchestration setup.
